sourceInspection.nonSubstitutionRule: Reusable production and action primitives do not become CampaignRevision, CalendarEntry or MasterContentIntent authority.

frozenAuthorityDecision.campaign: CampaignRevision is the append-only plan authority with version/CAS and exact brief/evidence refs.
frozenAuthorityDecision.calendar: CalendarEntry is the append-only schedule authority with timezone, local window, resolved instant, exact CampaignRevision and exact content Artifact refs.
frozenAuthorityDecision.intent: MasterContentIntent is the append-only creative-intent authority; generated master and channel variants remain canonical Artifacts related by ArtifactRelation.
frozenAuthorityDecision.variantNaming: ContentVariant is the canonical manifest/read-model name; ChannelVariant is a product-language compatibility alias only and MUST NOT create a second authority or table.
frozenAuthorityDecision.publication: Scheduling and publication are separate decisions. A scheduled CalendarEntry cannot imply or execute publication.
frozenAuthorityDecision.history: Reschedule and cancellation append a successor revision/decision and never overwrite the prior schedule or published Artifact.

requiredInvalidationRules: MasterContentIntent revision drift marks dependent master/variant readiness stale.
Master Artifact or ContentVariant exact-ref drift blocks schedule readiness until an explicit successor is accepted.
CampaignRevision drift blocks stale CalendarEntry execution but does not rewrite history.
Publication revocation or unknown provider outcome is surfaced independently and is never repaired by blind reschedule.
requiredVerification: same-tenant exact refs and cross-tenant fail-closed
idempotent command replay and expected-version conflict
timezone/DST ambiguous and nonexistent local-time cases
schedule collision detect, reject and explicit override decision
master/variant drift invalidation without historical overwrite
Store/API/strict SDK/Web/browser/security cumulative evidence on one release identity
next: Run two-round plan remediation to freeze the canonical name, authority ownership, command state machine, schedule/publication separation and verification matrix before any implementation.
